okx._note: Internal paper runtime; external exchange is public/read-only market data only

symbol_filters._max_spread_pct_note: Value is percent; 0.05 = 0.05% = 5 bps. Metrics feed must expose spread_pct in same convention.

calibration._note: Aligned with calibration.json. Use calibration.json as authoritative source.

advanced_ml._note: C-Group: Advanced ML Techniques — all opt-in via feature flags

meta_stacking._note: C1: Level-2 meta-model. blend_weight=how much stacking overrides base fusion

tcn_ensemble._note: C3: TCN + Transformer ensemble weighted by timeframe

adversarial_validation._note: C4: Detect backtest vs live distribution shift

conformal_prediction._note: C6: Prediction intervals with coverage guarantees

trade_management._note: D-Group: Trade Management — all opt-in via feature flags

progressive_trailing._note: D1: Breakeven + progressive trailing that tightens with profit (1R→BE, 1.5R→2.5ATR, 3R→1.5ATR, 5R→1ATR)

time_stop._note: D2: Close unprofitable positions after max_hold_hours

scaling_entry._note: D3: Kademeli entry (40/30/30 split with trend confirmation)

dynamic_exit._note: D4: ATR-based TP levels with ADX-adjusted exit percentages

reentry_logic._note: D5: Smart re-entry after SL with elevated thresholds and reduced size

data_quality._note: E-Group: Data Quality & Preprocessing — all opt-in via feature flags

outlier_detection._note: E1: Outlier detection, cleaning, and winsorization for training data

multi_exchange._note: E2: Multi-exchange price consensus and anomaly detection

adaptive_normalization._note: E3: Adaptive rolling z-score normalization with regime-aware window

symbol_portfolio._note: F-Group: Symbol Selection & Portfolio — all opt-in via feature flags

dynamic_selection._note: F1: Dynamic symbol selection based on per-symbol performance

sector_rotation._note: F2: Sector rotation with momentum-based bias

trade_frequency._note: F3: Trade frequency optimization to prevent overtrading

psychology._note: G-Group: Psychology & Behavioral — all opt-in via feature flags

drawdown_sizing._note: G1: Anti-martingale drawdown-based position sizing with recovery ramp-up

streak_adaptation._note: G2: Win/loss streak adaptation (confidence boost, size reduction, forced breaks)

equity_curve._note: G3: Equity curve trading (below MA30→50% size, below MA80→stop trading)

advanced_signals._note: H-Group: Advanced Technical Signals — all opt-in via feature flags

volume_profile._note: H1: VPVR with HVN/LVN detection for S/R levels and SL/TP placement

delta_divergence._note: H2: CVD-price divergence detection (bearish: new high + CVD down, bullish: new low + CVD up)

oi_divergence._note: H3: OI + price quadrant analysis (4 scenarios)

heikin_ashi._note: H4: Heikin Ashi trend confirmation (3+ candles = +5% confidence, doji = no trade)

market_structure._note: H5: Market structure (HH/HL/LH/LL, BOS, CHoCH detection)

advanced_execution._note: I-Group: Advanced Execution — all opt-in via feature flags

smart_order_routing._note: I1: Multi-exchange price comparison, best execution routing

iceberg_detection._note: I2: Iceberg order detection from orderbook patterns

advanced_math._note: K-Group: Advanced Mathematical Methods — all opt-in via feature flags

hurst_exponent._note: K1: Hurst exponent for trend persistence (H>0.6=trending, H<0.4=mean-reverting)

wavelet_decomposition._note: K2: Wavelet noise filtering and multi-frequency trend extraction

entropy_analysis._note: K3: Sample entropy for market complexity (low=predictable, high=chaotic)

kalman_filter._note: K4: Kalman filter trend extraction (less lag than MA, less noise than EMA)

hmm_regime._note: K5: HMM-based regime detection (4 states: bull/bear × low/high vol)

copula_tail._note: K6: Copula-based tail dependency for crash correlation risk

granger_causality._note: K7: Granger causality lead-lag detection between symbol pairs

advanced_rl._note: L-Group: Advanced RL/Deep Learning — all opt-in via feature flags

curriculum_learning._note: L2: Progressive difficulty training (trend → range → crash → all)

transfer_learning._note: L3: BTC→altcoin transfer learning with layer freezing

reward_decomposition._note: L4: Decomposed reward (pnl + risk + timing + holding + sizing)

synthetic_data._note: L5: Flash crash/squeeze/high-vol synthetic data augmentation

order_flow._note: M-Group: Order Flow & Microstructure — all opt-in via feature flags

vpin._note: M1: VPIN — informed trading probability from volume imbalance

trade_flow_imbalance._note: M2: Aggressor-side classification for buying/selling pressure

spoofing_detection._note: M3: Spoofing/layering detection from orderbook pattern changes

tick_analysis._note: M4: Tick-level metrics (volume accel, clustering, momentum) from OHLCV

trade_accounting._note: fee_bps=10 (taker), slippage_bps=50 aligned with paper_trading, spread_bps=1, partial_fill_rate=0.85, latency_ms_assumption=250. Adjust per exchange.

leverage_policy.reason: demo and live canary remain 1x for 14 days; post-canary leverage resolves only from confidence, wallet_pct and risk_config.tiers with live-readiness/operator gates
